candidates.name: Candle Meyers
candidates.compExp: To confirm — has held Director-level HR/payroll roles
candidates.headline: Twenty-five years of high-volume, multi-state payroll — and the systems range to pick up anything you put in front of her.
candidates.intro: Candle has run payroll at a scale this role will never quite reach: 1,400+ employees across seven states weekly at Dreamfields, 1,000+ across multiple states plus Canada and Mexico at Revere, 1,200+ across five states at Epic Fitness. Across that she has owned the whole cycle — timekeeping validation, audits and reconciliations, garnishments, bonuses and commissions, multi-jurisdiction tax compliance, and the employee and manager inquiries that come with it. Her systems range is unusually wide: ADP Workforce Now, Paycom, Paycor, Paylocity, Paychex, isolved, Kronos, SmartLinx, Workday, PeopleSoft. She has also led the function, not just run it — Director of HR, Payroll and Business Operations for three years, with AP/AR and a team under her.
fitBullets: Volume and jurisdiction complexity well beyond this seat — weekly payroll for 1,400+ across seven states, plus international payroll spanning the US, Canada and Mexico.
Genuinely platform-agnostic — twelve-plus payroll and HRIS systems in production use, including isolved, Paycom, Paylocity and Kronos, which are the closest neighbours to UKG Ready.

Has owned the relationship, not just the processing — Director-level ownership of HR, payroll and business operations, regular vendor partnership calls, and named point of contact for payroll and benefits questions.
Audit-first discipline — payroll audits, reconciliations and quality-control reviews as standing practice, and she describes adding a control step after resolving an issue so it cannot recur.
Straight about two gaps: she has not worked inside a PEO, and she has not used UKG Ready. She says both plainly rather than dressing them up, and makes the adaptability case instead.
Exceeds the education preference — MBA in Human Resource Management against an Associate's 'nice to have'.
candidates.cta: The scale, the systems range and the seniority are all there. One call should settle how many separate legal entities she has actually run at once, and whether a contract seat at this level holds her.

experience.title: Senior Payroll Specialist (Remote)
points: Processed weekly payroll for 1,400+ employees across seven states in isolved.
Administered hourly, salaried, commissioned and executive payroll, including monthly executive bonus and commission runs.
Ensured compliance with federal, state and local payroll tax, wage-and-hour and multi-state requirements.
Ran payroll audits, reconciliations and quality-control reviews; resolved discrepancies, garnishments and tax issues with HR, Finance and Benefits.

experience.title: Senior International Payroll / HR & Benefits Specialist (Contract)
points: Weekly and bi-weekly payroll for 1,000+ exempt and non-exempt employees across multiple US states, Canada and Mexico, in Paylocity.
Ran regular vendor partnership calls for problem solving and issue resolution.
Adapted HR practice to international hiring — differing employment and labour law across jurisdictions.
Payroll audits, reconciliations and employee record reviews to support regulatory compliance.

experience.title: Senior Payroll & Benefits Administrator
points: Bi-weekly payroll for 1,200+ employees across five states and roughly 80 club locations, in Paycor and Paycom.
Administered medical, dental, vision, life, disability and 401(k) programmes, including annual open enrolment.
Reconciled payroll, benefit deductions, carrier invoices and retirement contributions.
Primary point of contact for employee payroll and benefits enquiries.

experience.title: Director of Human Resources, Payroll & Business Operations
points: Directed HR, payroll, accounts payable and accounts receivable for daily business operations.
Full-cycle payroll for hourly, salaried, commissioned and bonus-eligible staff under federal and state regulation.
Oversaw recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management and benefits.
Prepared payroll, financial and operational reporting for leadership; led cross-functional teams.

experience.title: HR, Payroll, Benefits & Talent Acquisition Manager
points: Directed HR, payroll, benefits and talent acquisition for a skilled nursing and rehabilitation facility.
Full-cycle recruitment, onboarding and retention across clinical and administrative staff.
Trusted resource for employee relations, investigations, corrective action and policy interpretation.
